nodes.label: Storage Performance Development Kit (SPDK) Userspace I/O Engine
nodes.description: User-mode, polled-mode storage architecture providing zero-copy direct access to NVMe PCIe devices for ultra-low latency page caching in graph databases.

nodes.label: Dilated Causal Temporal Convolutional Network Engine
nodes.description: Sequential neural learning framework processing temporal graph event streams with receptive fields expanding exponentially without loss of temporal resolution.

nodes.label: CRYSTALS-Dilithium Post-Quantum Digital Signature Standard
nodes.description: NIST-standardized lattice-based digital signature protocol ensuring tamper-evident cryptographic signing for Merkle-DAG graph mutations.

nodes.label: CAMeL Tools Arabic NLP & Morphological Toolkit
nodes.description: Open-source Arabic NLP suite providing morphological analysis, dialect identification, named entity recognition, and POS tagging for entity resolution.

nodes.label: Multi-Query Attention (MQA) Memory-Efficient Transformer Kernel
nodes.description: Attention mechanism sharing key and value heads across attention channels to drastically reduce KV-cache memory bandwidth during LLM GraphRAG generation.
